questions.question:
In the question below two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statements**:

l. All parrots are birds.

ll. Some birds are butterflies.

**Conclusions**:

I. All butterflies are parrots.

II. Some parrots are butterflies.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

l. All parrots are birds.

ll. Some birds are butterflies.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/207d64d66d7d3598c7f958d16726400187c244fc50a578a61ec989b091bb8207.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All butterflies are parrots - False (No definite relation given between butterflies and parrots, so it can be possible only).

II. Some parrots are butterflies - False (No definite relation given between butterflies and parrots, so it can be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion I or II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs and two numbers (Not digits) the equation will be correct?

13 × 12 ÷ 36 + 11 – 7 = 35
questions.solution:
Given equation: 13 × 12 ÷ 36 + 11 – 7 = 35 .

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) + and ×, 36 and 7

Given: 13 × 12 ÷ 36 + 11 – 7 = 35 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 13 + __**12 ÷ 7**__ × 11 – 36 = 35 

⇒ 13 + __**1.72 × 11**__ – 36 = 35 

⇒ __**13 + 18.92**__ – 36 = 35 

⇒ __**31.92 - 36**__ = 35 

⇒ -4.08 ≠ 35

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) + and –, 12 and 7

Given: 13 × 12 ÷ 36 + 11 – 7 = 35 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**13 × 7 ÷ 36**__ - 11 + 12 = 35 

⇒ **__2.53__**__** + 11**__ – 12 = 35

⇒ __13.53** – 12**__ = 35

⇒ 1.53 ≠ 35

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) × and ÷, 13 and 36 

Given: 13 × 12 ÷ 36 + 11 – 7 = 35 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**36 ÷ 12**__ × 13 + 11 – 7 = 35 

⇒ __**3 × 13**__ + 11 – 7 = 35 

⇒ __**39**____** + 11**__ – 7 = 35 

⇒ __50 - 7__ = 35

⇒ 43 ≠ 35

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) × and ÷, 11 and 7

Given: 13 × 12 ÷ 36 + 11 – 7 = 35 

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ __**13 ÷ 12 × 36**__ + 7 – 11 = 35 

⇒ __**39 + 7**__ – 11 = 35 

⇒ __46** - 11**__ = 35

⇒ **35 = 35**

⇒ LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
